newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end up on late rebound.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end up on late rebound.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended higher on Friday, as strong sentiment in the automotive and agribusiness sectors helped the index rebound in late trading, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index ended 3.78 points, or 0.53 points, up at 712.22 points. Advancers led decliners by 76 to 46 with 78 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 689 billion rupiah against some 652 billion rupiah on Thursday.

"Players re-entered the market particularly in the agribusiness and automotive sectors and ignored reports of a delay in the launch of the deregulation package," one broker with a local brokerage firm said.

Indonesia has delayed the launch of its latest package of economic deregulation measures to early next month from June because of last month's general elections, the Harian Ekonomi Neraca newspaper reported on Friday.
Brokers said the market was likely to be active in the coming week, with the composite index likely to hover around its life high level.
